note: Synthetic status vocabulary. Original names are preserved; normalized concepts are what the assistant explains.

LOT_DONE.meaning_pt: Lote de vendas processado; ainda não significa dinheiro na conta.
LOT_DONE.meaning_en: Sales batch processed; this does not mean the money is in the account yet.

SCHEDULED.meaning_pt: Pagamento agendado para a data prevista; crédito ainda não confirmado.
SCHEDULED.meaning_en: Payment scheduled for the expected date; credit not confirmed yet.

SENT.meaning_pt: Pagamento enviado ao banco de destino; aguardando confirmação.
SENT.meaning_en: Payment sent to the destination bank; awaiting confirmation.

PAID.meaning_pt: Crédito confirmado na conta de recebimento.
PAID.meaning_en: Credit confirmed in the receiving account.
